Flaws: Has poor eyesight thanks to her past, her regeneration could not recover them.
Alignment: Lawful Evil

Personality: Alice is somewhat of the opposite to Eleanor, she is a highly ambitious Nephalem, granted her past experience, she knows what she wants and she will get it no matter what. She is also an unpredictable being, her actions can appear random to those who don’t know her at all, many would assume she has mental problems but in reality she was just practicing her orchestral performances. She can be seen as a closet pervert, yet merciless and ruthless with whoever she meets, she can be insane due to her hardship, yet she remains level headed throughout a confrontation. She isn't a mindless Nephalem either, whenever things go wrong, she always has a plan ahead, a strategist at best.

Backstory: Alice, much like her younger sister, Eleanor is a special rare species, a rare case of being born with the genetics of both different beings, the horns of a devil, the wings of an angel, but what’s most important is, she would naturally have more strengths and less weaknesses compared to a standalone devil or angel whom to have common weaknesses against each other. However, due to her existence being a nephalem, most would claim they are far too dangerous to be kept alive, thanks to what they’re truly capable of. Due to the law of a nephalem, like Eleanor, she is considered to be too dangerous to be kept alive, the devils and angels would never come to accept it, as they’ve found out when Eleanor was only in her teenager years, the demons would come to kidnap her, the father, who happens to be a devil, betrayed her mother, locking her away as she herself would be taken elsewhere.

Alice on the other hand managed to barely escape the invasion of the devils, but at the same time she lost her home, pretty much everything. Her dream of being a musician was long gone despite her talents for them. It was until one day, as she got weaker over time, other Nephalems who had managed to escape would find her, taking her in. Although she thought she would be safe and living more peacefully, she was wrong the entire time, she was forced to work, forced to train under heavy pressure. The amount of hardship she had to endure to keep her stay is intense, much rather she had shackles, permanently attached to her wrists and ankles. Despite her time with the Nephalems, she’s gotten to spend her time, whenever she can, to learn music once more, eventually honing skills into learning her own type of magic based on music.

Things would get worse when she has to start fighting in order to survive, fighting for the Nephalems, lurking to get supplies as well. Throughout her survival, she has suffered fatal wounds on herself, the others would make a belief that she’s useless, betraying her while silently exiling her away from their place. As of now, she had nowhere to go, residing in Nocturnis before she would’ve proven her worth as an orchestral performer, with her talent as a musician, she manages to land herself a job, until eventually even owning the place as the owner.

Skill(s): 
- Talented Instrumental player
- Great Cook
- Excellent Problem Solver
- Has basic Close Quarter Combat skills, at least to be able to defend herself

Magic(s): Alice possesses great magic, granted she is a Nephalem, being half angel and half devil, she can wield holy magic and dark magic, but not at the same time. She also has mastery over Harmonic themes.
Holy Magic:
- Holy Barrier - A barrier that protects her from all incoming attacks. The barrier will weaken the more hits it takes, breaking eventually.
- Holy Smite - A single target attack, very powerful, but can only be used once a day, and is predictable, a human can roll/dodge away in time as it does not cause an explosion.
- Holy Cure - An incantation that can only be used once a day, used to cure illnesses and poison.

Dark Magic: 
- Dark Flames - She can imbue her fists with dark flames, fiery purple, it doesn’t enhance her strength, but much rather she gains elemental dark magic to her attacks, lasts for 10 seconds before she needs to recast it again.
- Dark Bindings - Dark chains she could use to temporarily bind one target in place for a very short period of time.
- Black Miasma - A black cloud of smoke she could use as cover, it isn’t poisonous, but it covers the line of sight, greater than regular smoke while it also reduces their movement speed by 50% for 3 seconds.

Harmonic Magic: With her love for orchestral music and harmony, she has mastered the arts of harmonic magic, allowing her to perform the magic she has learned and mastered. The concept of her magic is based on two stages.
Lo Harmonic: The basic stage, where she can use only the most basic of spells regardless of where she is. Some of those include.
- Pellets: Basketball sized magic balls she can use as projectiles, can shoot up to 3 at once.
- Tunic Bounce: A barrier she can put up that allows her to block melee attacks and reflect small projectiles
- Zero Tune: A levitation skill she possesses, allowing her to ignore gravity while floating in the air.
- Melody Jump: A single use move, whenever she jumps once, can jump as high as 11 meters high, she will leave a cloud of music notes, acts like a detonating contact mine, should one touch it, will explode upon contact.
Hi Harmonic: Her enhanced stage, requiring her to cast an enchantment on herself, musical notes will be floating around herself as it is an indication of her enhancing her magic further, enhancing her basic spells while giving her access to stronger ones that can’t be casted through normal means.
- Hi Pellets: The projectiles would have double the size.
- Hi Tunic Bounce: The barrier being enhanced, she can block heavier attacks while being able to reflect larger projectiles.
- Gravity Manipulation: Within her Hi Harmonic, she can control the gravity depending on what she chooses to do.
     - Heavy Gravity: she can pinpoint where she wants the gravity to happen, in a 5 meter radius, increasing the gravity will reduce their movement speed by 60%.
     - Zero Gravity: Cannot pinpoint, but instead she would reduce the gravity from a 8 meter radius around her and can use it as an attack for herself to slam her opponent down., can also destroy objects within the range around her.
- Calling ball: A super charged version of Pellets, tracks, moves very slowly (2km/h) and has a set distance it can travel (Maximum of 10 meters) before it explodes, explosion splash range is about 5 meter radius
- Hi Melody Jump: Same properties as her basic Melody Jump but leaves a decoy that can act as a distraction while it performs various music performances as it can fire basic pellets at most.
- Harmonic Waves: An air slash like projectile that can be fired from the use of her orchestral baton, the size of the wave is equal to 2 meters in length, the width being 20 centimeters.

Supernatural(s): 
- Regeneration: Can heal wounds depending on how severe, but once decapitated, she’s dead. Healing missing limbs would take her about 2 days, broken ribs would take 2 hours, should her skull be damaged, it would take about as long as restoring broken ribs but will render her at risk if she's in a fight.
- Super Speed: Able to move faster than the speed of sound, she can outrun any existing vehicle as she is also able to run on water.
- Enhanced hearing: Has heightened hearing senses, allowing her to pick up sound more easily compared to an average human’s
- Retractable Wings: Granted her species, she naturally has wings she can spread and use for flight and other means, but they’re black due to her species.

Weapons: The main weapon she uses is her signature orchestral baton, should she lose it, she can call it back by resummoning it by using a bit of her mana.
